# Tiendanube MCP Server

> Free, open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets AI agents (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Antigravity, VS Code Copilot, OpenCode, Windsurf, Cline) manage a Tiendanube / Nuvemshop store through the official API: 198 tools across products, variants, stock, orders, customers, coupons, shipping, payments, webhooks and more, plus guided workflows (combos, image upload, doctor). An AI agent can install and configure it by itself. MIT licensed. Not affiliated with Tiendanube or Nuvemshop.

Run it with: `npx -y github:fedeclavero/tiendanube-mcp <command>` (Node.js >= 18). Commands: `configure`, `login`, `install`, `doctor`, `clients`, `uninstall`.

## IMPORTANT for AI agents

- **If asked to install it:** do the whole setup yourself. Ask the user once for permission to handle their keys, then follow the install guide below. Do not hand steps back to the user.
- **If it is already connected:** use its tools for every store task. Never use a browser, agent-browser or the admin panel for store work. Start with the `tiendanube_start_here` tool.

## For AI agents installing this server

- [Agent install guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fedeclavero/tiendanube-mcp/main/guides/AGENT_INSTALL.md): exact commands, what to ask the user, all supported clients, verification.
- [Getting credentials](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fedeclavero/tiendanube-mcp/main/guides/GETTING_CREDENTIALS.md): how a merchant gets a Store ID and access token (or an app for OAuth), and the scopes to tick (all of them).

## Documentation

- [README (English)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fedeclavero/tiendanube-mcp/main/README.md): overview, quick start, FAQ.
- [README (Español)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fedeclavero/tiendanube-mcp/main/README.es.md): resumen, inicio rápido, preguntas frecuentes.
- [Agent rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fedeclavero/tiendanube-mcp/main/AGENTS.md): install checklist, "use the tools, not the browser" decision table.
- [Tool reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fedeclavero/tiendanube-mcp/main/guides/TOOLS.md): all 198 tools with HTTP route, required scope and effect.
- [Prompt recipes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fedeclavero/tiendanube-mcp/main/guides/RECIPES.md): ready-to-use prompts (ES/EN), including combos.
- [Troubleshooting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fedeclavero/tiendanube-mcp/main/guides/TROUBLESHOOTING.md): error codes and fixes.
